ILCallClassificationRequest.doc: A classification request for phone calls.

ILCallCommunication.doc: A concrete subclass representing a phone call.

ILClassificationRequest.doc: The abstract superclass for classification requests.

ILClassificationResponse.doc: A response object that tells the system how to handle the reported communications.

ILCommunication.doc: An abstract superclass representing a message or call to the user.

ILMessageClassificationRequest.doc: A classification request for SMS messages.

ILMessageCommunication.doc: A concrete subclass representing a SMS message.

ILMessageFilterCapabilitiesQueryRequest.doc: A request to query a Message Filter extension about sharing its sub-category capabilities.

ILMessageFilterCapabilitiesQueryResponse.doc: A response to a message filter capabilities query request.

ILMessageFilterExtension.doc: The abstract base class for the principal class of a Message Filter app extension.

ILMessageFilterExtensionContext.doc: The extension context for a Message Filter app extension.

ILMessageFilterQueryRequest.doc: A request for a Message Filter app extension to determine the status of a message received from an unknown sender.

ILMessageFilterQueryResponse.doc: A response to a message filter query request.

ILNetworkResponse.doc: A response to an HTTPS network request performed on behalf of a Message Filter app extension.

ILMessageFilterCapabilitiesQueryHandling.doc: A set of methods implemented by a Message Filter app extension to handle capabilities query requests.

ILMessageFilterQueryHandling.doc: A set of methods implemented by a Message Filter app extension to handle query requests.

ILClassificationAction.doc: The actions the system can take in response to the reported communication.

ILClassificationActionReportJunk.doc: The system should report the communication as junk.

ILClassificationActionReportJunkAndBlock.doc: The system should report the communication as junk and add the number to the system’s block list.

ILClassificationActionReportNotJunk.doc: The system should report that the communication is not junk.

ILMessageFilterAction.doc: Responds to a received message with a filter action.

ILMessageFilterActionAllow.doc: Allows the system to show the message unfiltered.

ILMessageFilterActionFilter.doc: Prevents the system from showing the message unfiltered.

ILMessageFilterActionJunk.doc: Prevents the system from showing the message normally, filtered as a Junk message.

ILMessageFilterActionNone.doc: Allows the system to show the message unfiltered due to insufficient information to determine an action.

ILMessageFilterActionPromotion.doc: Prevents the system from showing the message normally, filtered as a Promotional message.

ILMessageFilterActionTransaction.doc: Prevents the system from showing the message normally, filtered as a Transactional message.

ILMessageFilterError.doc: An error type that indicates problems with network requests and responses related to IdentityLookup APIs.

ILMessageFilterSubAction.doc: Responds to a received message with a filter subaction.

ILMessageFilterSubActionNone.doc: Allows the system to show the message unfiltered due to insufficient information to determine an action.

ILMessageFilterSubActionPromotionalCoupo.doc: Prevents the system from showing the message normally, filtered as an Coupons message.

ILMessageFilterSubActionPromotionalOffer.doc: Prevents the system from showing the message normally, filtered as an Offers message.

ILMessageFilterSubActionPromotionalOther.doc: Prevents the system from showing the message normally, filtered as an Others message.

ILMessageFilterSubActionTransactionalCar.doc: Prevents the system from showing the message normally, filtered as a Carrier message.

ILMessageFilterSubActionTransactionalFin.doc: Prevents the system from showing the message normally, filtered as a Finance message.

ILMessageFilterSubActionTransactionalHea.doc: Prevents the system from showing the message normally, filtered as a Health message.

ILMessageFilterSubActionTransactionalOrd.doc: Prevents the system from showing the message normally, filtered as an Orders (eCommerce) message.

ILMessageFilterSubActionTransactionalOth.doc: Prevents the system from showing the message normally, filtered as an Others message.

ILMessageFilterSubActionTransactionalPub.doc: Prevents the system from showing the message normally, filtered as a Government message.

ILMessageFilterSubActionTransactionalRem.doc: Prevents the system from showing the message normally, filtered as a Reminder message.

ILMessageFilterSubActionTransactionalRew.doc: Prevents the system from showing the message normally, filtered as a Rewards message.

ILMessageFilterSubActionTransactionalWea.doc: Prevents the system from showing the message normally, filtered as a Weather message.

-isEqualToCallCommunication:.doc: Indicates whether the current phone call is equal to the provided argument.

-initWithClassificationAction:.doc: Creates a new response using the provided classification.

-isEqualToCommunication:.doc: Indicates whether the current communication is equal to the provided argument.

-isEqualToMessageCommunication:.doc: Indicates whether the current message is equal to the provided argument.

-deferQueryRequestToNetworkWithCompletio.doc: Tells the system to pass the current query request to the app extension’s associated network service.

callCommunications.doc: The calls the user selected to report.

action.doc: A classification that determines what action the system takes.

userInfo.doc: JSON data included in a response sent over the network.

userString.doc: Text included in a response sent over SMS.

dateReceived.doc: The date and time when the system received the message.

sender.doc: The email address or phone number of the sender.

messageCommunications.doc: The messages the user selected to report.

messageBody.doc: The content of the SMS message.

promotionalSubActions.doc: The promotional action the Message Filter app extension recommends that the system perform on the queried message.

transactionalSubActions.doc: The transactional action the Message Filter app extension recommends that the system perform on the queried message.

messageBody.doc: The body of a message received from an unknown sender.

receiverISOCountryCode.doc: The ISO Country Code of the receiving phone number, in format specified by the ISO 3166-2 standard.

action.doc: The action the Message Filter app extension recommends that the system perform on the queried message.

subAction.doc: The subaction the Message Filter app extension recommends that the system perform on the queried message.

data.doc: The data returned in the HTTPS response.

urlResponse.doc: Encapsulation of an HTTPS URL response.
